check_lessons_exemplar_invariants.name: check_lessons_exemplar_invariants
check_lessons_exemplar_invariants.value: ("lessons"."is_exemplar" = false) OR ("lessons"."is_exemplar" = true AND "lessons"."exemplar_competency" IS NOT NULL AND "lessons"."exemplar_age_band" IS NOT NULL AND "lessons"."exemplar_approved_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "lessons"."access_tier" = 'free' AND "lessons"."origin" = 'human')

chk_audit_logs_actor.name: chk_audit_logs_actor
chk_audit_logs_actor.value:
("audit_logs"."actor_type" = 'system' AND "audit_logs"."actor_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("audit_logs"."actor_type" <> 'system' AND "audit_logs"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL)

check_personal_curricula_age_range.name: check_personal_curricula_age_range
check_personal_curricula_age_range.value: "personal_curricula"."age_min" IS NULL OR "personal_curricula"."age_max" IS NULL OR "personal_curricula"."age_min" <= "personal_curricula"."age_max"

check_play_sessions_identity.name: check_play_sessions_identity
check_play_sessions_identity.value: "play_sessions"."child_profile_id" IS NOT NULL OR "play_sessions"."guest_device_id" IS NOT NULL
